Name: Wild Doves - Brown Bird Replacement
Author: ebenaceae
Description:
What happens to your kids when they get turned into doves? They stay in Stardew Valley, apparently. Pretend your kids now live in the forest with this brown bird replacement! 

(You don't have to abandon your kids to use this mod. Maybe you just don't like the colour brown.)

To install:

>go to C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley or wherever your Stardew Valley files are located.
>go to \Content and then \TileSheets 
>replace critters.xmb in the \TileSheets folder with the downloaded file.

Enjoy!
